english.note: This is the all-purpose colloquial choice for something astonishing, extreme, or overwhelming.

examples.english: The year-end bonuses at your company are staggering; everyone is grinning from ear to ear.
examples.traditional: 你哋間公司個年終獎金好誇張，人人都笑到見牙唔見眼。
